_why: The default is the whole point of #18, and a default that silently does nothing is indistinguishable from the opt-in flag it replaced. Every mutation carries its own `test` key so a wrong-catcher is not scored as a kill.

mutations.name: design-derives-from-the-plan-dir
mutations._mechanism: Design documents do not live beside the others. One directory for everything makes every design cycle derive a path that is not there, i.e. silently turns the default off for the phase that needs it most.

mutations.name: an-absent-derived-path-is-forwarded-anyway
mutations._mechanism: THE safety property. An unreadable --gated is GATE: UNSTAMPABLE, a cannot-judge; forwarding a path that is not there would halt a live lane's next audit in any repo with another layout.

mutations.name: the-default-overrides-an-explicit-gated
mutations._mechanism: An explicit flag must win. A default that overrides it stamps a file the caller did not choose and looks correct doing it.
mutations.find: if not gated and not args.no_gate:

mutations.name: no-gate-is-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The escape hatch for a cycle that must not stamp. Ignored, there is no way back to the old behaviour.
mutations.find: if not gated and not args.no_gate:

mutations.name: contradictory-flags-are-accepted
mutations._mechanism: Two sources for one field is how they disagree -- the same refusal --project-tests and --suite-result already carry.

mutations.name: the-missing-derivation-goes-silent
mutations._mechanism: Absence was silent in BOTH directions and the silence is the defect. A default that quietly declines is the opt-in flag again.
